title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki CentralNotice Extension versions 1.43, 1.45, and 1.46. This vulnerability is due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker to inject malicious scripts. The issue has a low severity rating with a CVSS score of 2.3. No public exploits or patches are currently documented.
